label: Bible Study
prompt: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our _____: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verse: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
note: 'Let us make man' — the only creation act with a divine conversation before it, and the image comes with a job: dominion.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into _____, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verse: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
note: Swords into plowshares, spears into pruninghooks — Micah's picture of a world that's finished with war.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Are not Abana and Pharpar, _____ of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verse: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
note: Naaman was insulted: Damascus had better rivers than the muddy Jordan — why dip in that?

label: Deep Water
prompt: And of some have _____, making a difference:
verse: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
note: Jude's fiery letter softens here: for the wavering, compassion first — care can make the difference.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy _____ delight my soul.
verse: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
note: When anxious thoughts multiply, God's 'comforts' delight the soul — the KJV's answer to a racing mind at 3 a.m.
